records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Sales of Grand Theft Auto products generated 33.7% of our net revenue for the three months ended June 30, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended June 30, 2021, Net Bookings decreased by $284.8 million as compared to the prior year period due primarily to a decrease in Net Bookings from Grand Theft Auto Online and Grand Theft Auto V, our NBA 2K franchise, Red Dead Redemption 2, Borderlands 3, and The Outer Worlds, partially offset by an increase in Net Bookings from Two Dots, which was part of the Playdots acquisition in September 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We had two customers who accounted for 47.7% and 17.6%, respectively, of our gross accounts receivable as of June 30, 2021 and two customers who accounted for 50.4% and 18.8%, respectively, of our gross accounts receivable as of March 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Changes in foreign currency exchange rates decreased total operating expenses by $2.0 million for the three months ended June 30, 2021, as compared to the prior year period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended June 30, 2021, net revenue decreased by $18.0 million as compared to the prior year period.
